spans.s: tṛtiya, adj. (= Pali tatiya, Skt. tṛtīya), third; rare and only m.c. in BHS: SP 〔92.7〕; LV 〔111.11〕; by em. (mss. tṛtī˚), m.c., SP 〔46.11〕; Mv 〔i.174.16〕; in Gv 〔256.7〕 text tṛtī˚, should be tṛti˚ m.c. All vss. Cf. s.v. dvitiya.
tṛtīyakam, adv. (= Pali tatiyakaṃ, Skt. tṛtīyam; see also traitīyakam), for the third time; SP 〔315.4, 9, 11〕; Mv 〔i.347.2 ff.〕; 〔iii.49.2, 7, 9〕; 〔189.8〕; AsP 〔182.13〕. All prose.
